design.chosen: declarative reusable workflow registry/compiler over Code Mode
design.why: The declarative compiler reuses Code Mode's typed execution, traces, artifacts, retries, diffs, rollback and self-update semantics instead of duplicating them in generated scripts. Structured parameter nodes and literal argv also make parameter handling safer and more auditable.

capabilities: immutable name@version workflow definitions with SHA256 identity
literal argv execution for parameterized commands/jobs
promotion of successful Code Mode runs into parameterized reusable workflows with provenance
workflow-level traces plus retained concrete Code Mode workflow and step trace
explicit reusable Lab candidate verification/acceptance/post-verification lifecycle

self_hosting.effect: The new reusable mechanism modified the Lab server so lab_status advertises Gen-3 Code Mode and reusable-workflow identity without changing the MCP schema.

implementation_findings.finding: Self-update correctly preserves the previous LKG while a new build is only CANDIDATE_INSTALLED.
implementation_findings.response: Added distinct lab-candidate-verify, lab-accept-current and lab-post-update-verify workflows instead of weakening LKG verification.

implementation_findings.finding: Reusable workflow CLI initially exited 0 even when the underlying Code Mode run failed.
implementation_findings.response: Patched workflow_skills.py using the reusable exact-replace workflow; failed workflow runs now exit 1.

gen4_top_recommendation.title: Composable workflow graphs + lifecycle transactions
gen4_top_recommendation.evidence: Generation 3 reduced authored workflow bytes by 67.4%, but 8 of the 18 benchmark reusable invocations were lifecycle/recovery invocations. Normal self-update still sequences four named workflows and bad recovery three.

reason_no_refresh: The permanent Optiplex_Lab MCP tool schema remained exactly the accepted 10-tool surface.
recursive_mcp_rule: Never run /opt/optiplex-lab/mcp_probe.py synchronously through Optiplex_Lab.shell; use connector schema discovery or detached/out-of-band probing.
